results.question: What is your return policy?
results.reply:
You can return your items for free within 30 days from the delivery or store purchase date [1][3]. 

To be eligible for a return, items must:
* Be unworn, unaltered, and free from any signs of wear [1][3].
* Have the original tags attached [1][3].
* Have been delivered or ready for pick up less than 30 days ago [1][3].
* Be returned in the same country of purchase (cross-country returns are not permitted) [1][3]. 

Items altered using Size Passport are also eligible for a full refund as long as they meet these criteria [4].

results.question: How long does it take to get my refund once my return arrives at the warehouse?
results.reply: Once your return arrives at the warehouse, return processing takes up to 5 business days, and refunds are then issued 1–2 business days after processing [1].

results.question: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
results.reply: No, return shipping is completely free of charge [1][4].

results.question: Can someone come and collect my parcel for a return?
results.reply: Yes, you can schedule a pickup on the UPS website using your return label tracking number and following the instructions under "Need a collection?" [1].

results.question: Is there a longer return period around Christmas?
results.reply: Yes! For purchases made between November 1st and December 25th, we offer an extended 60-day return period [1].

results.question: I paid with a gift card. How will I be refunded if I return the item?
results.reply: If you return an item purchased with a gift card, the credit will be issued to a new gift card [1][2].

results.question: Can I return an online order in a store?
results.reply: Yes, you can return an online order in any store in the same country where it was purchased [1].

results.question: How long does delivery to Germany take?
results.reply: Delivery to Germany takes 1-5 business days [1].

results.question: Do you charge for shipping?
results.reply: Suitsupply offers free worldwide shipping [2].

results.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
results.reply: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, and additional local payment methods [1].

results.question: Do your gift cards expire?
results.reply: No, our gift cards do not have an expiration date [1].

results.question: How long do alterations take?
results.reply: Alterations generally take anywhere from 30 minutes to 3 days, done by our expert in-store tailors [1]. Certain alterations, such as taking in/let out side seams, shortening/lengthening sleeves, or a square back neck, take 2 to 3 days [2].

results.question: How much does it cost to shorten my trousers?
results.reply: Shortening trousers costs €12 [1].

results.question: Do I need an appointment to visit a store?
results.reply: While walk-ins are always welcome, we do encourage you to make an appointment to ensure minimal wait time and that a dedicated associate is available to help you [1][3].

results.question: What is Size Passport?
results.reply: Size Passport is a helpful tool that saves your measurements so you can order products in the best-fitting size [1][2]. It allows eligible pieces to be tailored to your fit before they arrive [5].

results.question: How long does it take to receive a Custom Made suit?
results.reply: It typically takes 3-4 weeks to get your Custom Made suit designed, crafted, and delivered [1].

results.question: What is the customer service phone number in the Netherlands?
results.reply: The customer service phone number for the Netherlands is 0800 020 6227 [1][2].

results.question: Can I reach customer service on WhatsApp?
results.reply: Yes, you can reach customer service via WhatsApp at +31 655 110 516, and it is free [2][3]!

results.question: Which natural fibers do you use in your products?
results.reply: We use several natural fibers across our collection! For example, we offer products made with pure wool [1], linen silk wool cotton blends [2], pure linen [3, 4, 5, 6, 7], and wool silk linen blends [8].

results.question: What time does the Amsterdam store open on Sunday?
results.reply: The Sunday opening hours for the Amsterdam store are 11:00 - 18:00 [1].

results.question: Where is your store in Rotterdam?
results.reply: Our store in Rotterdam is located at Rodezand 9-13, 3011 AM Rotterdam [1].
